name: CHAPSPaymentIntent
description: A CHAPS-specific payment intent created by SVC-001 when PER-001 initiates a CHAPS payment. Distinct from ENT-008 (PaymentIntent/FPS) due to different state machine, mandatory ISO 20022 fields, and mortgage completion linkage. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001).

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: FK → ENT-004. Must be active. Immutable.

fields.name: beneficiary_lei
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 17442 LEI. Mandatory for corporate beneficiaries from 1 May 2025.

fields.name: amount_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Positive, max 2dp. Must be <= Account.available_balance at authorisation.

fields.name: purpose_code
fields.validation_rule: ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code. Enum enforced. PROP for property purchase.

fields.name: mortgage_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → ENT-016. Required when is_mortgage_completion_payment=true.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: initiated | cop_pending | cop_complete | sanctions_pending | sanctions_complete | authorised | executed | completed | failed | cancelled. Forward-only.

relationships.description: CHAPSPaymentIntent produces one CHAPSPaymentExecution in SVC-009 (CAP-003). Cross-capability.

design_decisions.rationale: CHAPS initiation orchestration (CoP → sanctions → SCA) differs from FPS (fraud score → sanctions → CoP at end). Different state machine, different required fields. Extending ENT-008 would produce a sparse entity with ~40% nullable fields.
